The '''Tion system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in the area known as the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tion]].
